scripts.build:android: vite build --mode android-public && cap sync android
scripts.build:android:emulator: vite build --mode android-emulator && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run build:android && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:android && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run build:android && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:assembleRelease
